Name: Useful Sweet Gem Berries
Author: SilentDeath06
Description:
Sweet Gem Berry is the most valuable crop of the game but it's not edible and has no use apart from getting the Stardrop from Old Master Cannoli in the Secret Woods. Its a simple [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] mod makes it recognized as a fruit in-game and hence can be used in a Keg or Preserves Jar to make Jelly or Wine. To install simply Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and unzip it into the Mods folder.[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]
[/url]
For easier access to Rare Seeds use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/814]Generic Shop Extender[color=#f4f4f4]. Install Generic Shop Extender and change its config.json data to
[/color][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/814][color=#f4f4f4]
{
  "shopkeepers": {
    "Pierre": [
      [
        347,
        600
      ]
    ]
  }
}

and Pierre will sell Rare seeds for 600[/color][/url].
